newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds close mixed, unsure over direction.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds close mixed, unsure over direction.

text.p: UK meals and feed closed mixed but tradeless as sterling gyrations against both the mark and the dollar left traders sidelined.

Traders had felt that lower levels were likely following losses on Friday's Chicago soybean meal futures, but that the currency uncertainty coupled with an erratic start to early Chicago trading had left people playing a waiting game.
Soybean meal selling levels in the UK closed mostly one sterling lower to one higher.
